headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text:
This situation is becoming very frustrating. I was informed that this repair is needed, yet nothing has happened for months.

If the City does not expect to repair it for another year or two, please let me know. I would much rather receive an honest estimate than continue being told it is “on a list” with no expected schedule, timeline, or completion date.

Clear communication about the anticipate

There is an injured possum on the ladybird Lake Trail near the ramp to go onto South first. It’s on the north side of the trail so just like between the bridge the first street bridge and the ramp the walk up ramp that goes to the bridge it needs help.

Strewn debris in ROW and in bike lane by homeless man. This crap needs to be cleaned up ASAP, please. This is not the first time a complaint has been issued for this mess and it just keeps getting worse.

Howard ln west to east traffic light only stays green for 5 seconds every night after 9pm, this is not normal, only 3 card goes and 5  other cars goes jn red which is very dangerous. Something needs to change with this light schedule

While walking my dog in the neighborhood we were attacked by 2 dogs - I kept screaming and tried to separate them but the just kept attacking and the owner did not come or help. A car passing by stopped to help so I could get away
road and right of way dumping, busted trailer, tires. ARR bin from somewhere needs to be picked up. stone blocks shifted? but shouldn't there be a little guardrail and something reflective to warn?

Alley street light out. Please replace with the older style warm/yellow lights, not the cool/blue lights. It’s right outside my bedroom window, and the warm light is much easier to block/not absurdly bright. Thank you!

Can hear Luna through my noise canceling headphones. City of Austin do something?? Still not sure how they were granted an omv in the first place (numerous offenses/playing music without permit for months and getting citations the whole time).

I want to report an anonymous animal welfare check for 7495 Chevy Chase Dr, Building 34B. There is a dog left in the backyard that has been whining and making distressed sounds continuously since this afternoon. I am concerned the dog may be neglected, hungry, or lacking proper care. Please have an officer check on the animal.

Gray ford f150 completely blocking sidewalk and dumpster access. It’s a joke how they even parked this way. Please tow. Almost every day a car parks on the front of rear sidewalk of this restaurant. I’ve asked both them and the city to add more signs for ROW and they won’t. It’s been six months of this.

LUNA bar on 5th street is blasting music so loud, I can hear loud and clear in my bedroom in high rise across the street. This is so unacceptable to have C residences and these roof top open music venues. Can someone visit and ask them to stop?

Cars on side of road are taking up space , leaving only one lane for a busy street . Care drive fast through here. People’s cars have also been hit and run. These cars are broken down or don’t move. Some have been here for 3 years. Blocking school traffic and daily traffic every day! Signs were moved or broken down.

PARD why do yall loving mowing so much. Why did you do this? It has been raining all summer.  This was not a fire hazard. Please stop mowing in the peak of growing season. You’re going to kill the seed bank.

LOOSE DOG tan pitbull/lab male dog running around near w parmer ln at 7/11 initially dog then ran underneath bridge under w parmer ln near Zaviya Grill. Dog has grey/green collar with silver chain collar, dog seemed friendly but I couldn’t catch him.

There are probably 100 fire ant nests around the Metz Park playground, splashpad and athletic courts closer to the river. They are invasive and pose a hazard to the public, especially children and pets. No one can even use the fields without stepping in one. Both my kids got bit just walking around. Nests need to have bait applied

Illegal camping at Ben White and Menchaca near Sunrise Church. Please remove trash as well as stolen bikes and piles of trash. This whole area should be fenced off, especially the area that connects to the bus stop and should have a constant police presence.

Someone stole a recycling bin, filled it with trash and then left it blocking the road. I called about it on Wednesday. Now, someone else has moved the bin to the curb right in front of our house but it needs to be removed. My neighbor and I have both called about this, so I’d appreciate it the care to get it taken care of.

Invasive Chinaberry Tree on City property (behind 2705 & 2707 Acopio Bend & in between Cameron Loop tiny home and RV park. It's spreading into adjacent yards. Tree bark photo is a tree that's spread into my yard. I was wondering if the City will remove it since it's spreading and unsafe for pets and kids. Thank you.

Late last night a large dog was barking in our yard and banging on a rain barrel on the front corner of our house.  Today our front step, driveway, and the sidewalk have big bloody paw prints from here to 1810 Krizan.  The prints look like maybe the dog’s own blood, like it might be hurt.  2 big, loud, muscular dogs often get out from 1810 Krizan.  Other instances of blood and dead small animals h

Bike lane marking disappears — The bike lane on northbound South Lamar loses its markings for the stretch immediately north of Menchaca Road, inaccurately signaling drivers in the far east lane that there’s no need to look for bikists
Luna is once again being excessively loud at 0:52 on a Thursday night! Are you ever going to enforce a sound limit on this place or is it always going to spread noise pollution in this downtown?

Amplified music from NAYA is clearly audible inside my residence at Austin City Lofts with my doors and windows closed. The music can also be heard at a significantly higher volume from my balcony. I have video recordings from both inside my bedroom and from my balcony documenting the noise. The amplified music has continued late into the evening and is interfering with my ability to enjoy and sle

COA Mowing request
I have gotten off the phone with code compliance (Trey) and determined that this section of the park is maintained by city of Austin and not Goodnight ranch. The field hasn’t been mowed all year only the right of ways around the pathway.  It used to be regularly maintained so we can use the field. The side that goodnight ranch maintains is properly cut. Trey with code compliance

Homeless Encampment on the side of mopac on the Scofield exit right across from HEB on parmer/ mopac. Tents and garbage littering the street. Called it in last week and it was scheduled for cleanup by the homeless department on the 14th but the city failed to clean it up and now it’s getting larger by the day…
items.address: 12421 N Mopac Expy Svrd NB, Austin

items.text:
Leftover sediment from an Austin water work operation from 10510 school house lane north to lake creek.  Work order 2370932

WSP requested they order a street sweeper to clean up the sediment from the work. And rain is coming so if this can be done today. That would be great.

Employee Kenzie Green was bitten on her right index finger while holding a cat in exam assessment for Katelyn. The Patient was fine until they went to get the BP. Patient reacted to the alcohol on their paw pad and lashed out. 

Dr. Campbell has notified the owner. Patient is up to date on their rabies. Kenzie is going out to Urgent Care right now.
items.address: 7501 N Capital of Texas Hwy NB, Austin

items.text: The man that drums on buckets at the corner of 6th and Congress in front of CAVA has a baby kitten leashed to his “drum” that’s clearly terrified of all the people and loud noises in the direct sunlight. The cat barely looks old enough to even be away from its mother if it even is.

Brown pitbull loose on hollybluff st, lives at 1115 hollybluff. Their fence is broken, this dog is out several times a week, in the road where it could be hit by a car. It barks at people. It scares children. It is a road hazard. The owners have no interest in keeping their dog fenced and safe.

Trash and (adult) human feces in children’s playscape. My wife and I daily walk this park and clean up, especially around the playscape. Over the last week several individuals have increasingly strewn trash around. Today was the worst (so far). I cleaned up foodstuffs, clothing, personal items, and feces. Yes, human sh**. I don’t fault homeless for being in the park but using the playscape, where

Vehicle parked with its front end extending over the public sidewalk, blocking the pedestrian pathway and forcing people to walk around it into the street or adjacent property. This creates a safety hazard and an accessibility issue, particularly for wheelchair users and strollers.

Vehicle parked with its front end extending over the public sidewalk, blocking the pedestrian pathway and forcing people to walk around it into the street or adjacent property. This creates a safety hazard and an accessibility issue, particularly for wheelchair users and strollers.

One street and cars parked on side of road , makes hard to see cars coming and creates traffic also blocking school buses. Since 2022. Signs are getting knocked down. Vehicles are not in use or are broken down. Drivers have hard time sharing this road going two ways.

Right now there are numerous cars illegally double parked outside this house where they obstruct traffic on a double yellow fire route.

This house regularly does this, blocking an entire lane of traffic on a bend in a road with heavy traffic, substantially increasing vehicle and pedestrian risk.

This property - which is now under construction - continues failing to maintain their curbfront, specifically the city ordinances for removing debris from the right of way in front of their property.

There are rocks, trees, sticks, and leaves 2+ feet into the roadway, creating a danger for both pedestrians and motorists.  The cause is the property owners failure to properly maintain their curb, s

There is a property development project in Lost Creek by developer “Milestone”.  Our property is immediately adjacent to them. The recent rain has resulted in catastrophic flooding and silt run off onto our property. I have videos that captures the event live, but the app won’t let me upload. I’ve been working with the developer to address the issue but thus far have had unsatisfactory resolution.

Streetlight out with a bike may use full lane sign. Across the street one lamp before it on a curb in front of Zalat Pizza is missing a bulb altogether. 363067 is the one without a cover and bulb, number pulled off Google Maps and was blurry so may be off.

Debris from camp washes down from Howard and Metric. This is in the creek. There a lot of trash around but this is a problem of ~9 shopping baskets and construction materials. 

Access is on Kincaid, go into woods where the fire hydrant is, go down to creek/limestone outcrop and look right (less than 20 yards from hydrant).

Active barn swallow nest was removed. Nest was present at 2:30pm today. Gone by 5:15pm today. Parent was sitting in nest for the past couple weeks and as recently as today. we believe we heard baby birds on Sunday evening in the nest. No sign of nest or birds. We asked apartment management and they indicated they knew nothing about removal

Dog in distress. Hours upon hours of continuous barking. Dog left alone in home or garage. Barking goes on for hours and hours. We can’t sleep we can’t think we can’t concentrate without putting on loud music in our home. This goes on for days at a time. Reporting dog in distress maybe neglected or abandoned. Very concerned.

Overgrown Tree Obstructing Sidewalk at 12701 cardinal flower drive 

A residential tree adjacent to the sidewalk has branches extending into the pedestrian path and does not provide the required minimum vertical clearance for safe passage.
